title: Why films mattered to him
summary: He says films reached more people than he could on stage, though he rarely saw his own pictures.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: The films had more meaning then, more meaning, because I was entertaining more people. Do you understand? That film was going to more places than I can be.
Well, then I would think that you would remember those films then and your performance in those films and how they were received by audiences.
That was my enthusiasm. That's what gave me the enthusiasm, how you're going to take them before the audience.
Did you go to the theaters where they were being shown?

If I ever saw it. If it were billed somewhere, I'd go, but when do I see it? I do it out here and nobody tells me we're coming to New York. Take a chance on seeing it. That's the agent, somebody who tells you ahead of time what you're going to do, who in the picture is going.
